== Related skills ==
*{{skill icon|Harrier's Toss}}<!--A moving target also meets the "not using a skill" damage trigger of Sloth Hunter's Shot, since a moving target can't use a skill with an activation time without stopping their movement.-->
*{{skill icon|Melandru's Shot}} ([[Elite skill|elite]])<!--A moving or knocked down target also meets the "not using a skill" damage trigger of Sloth Hunter's Shot, since a moving or knocked down target can't use a skill with an activation time without stopping their movement nor while knocked down, respectively.-->

==Notes==
* If you [[interrupt]] with this skill (while target is [[Dazed]] for example), the interrupt occurs first, then the bonus damage is applied, even if the target was using a skill.
* Consider using along with [[shutdown]] methods, such as interrupts, to give yourself a window of time in which to hit.

==Trivia==
* The figure in this [[skill icon]] is a female necromancer wearing [[Necromancer Cabal armor|Cabal armor]] and a [[blindfold]].
